entries.text: How did you like the midterm exam? You all did\nreally great![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_05_language_01

entries.text: We’re halfway there! And now, time for another\nlesson! Êtes-vous prêts—are you ready?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_05_language_02

entries.text: Yes!
entries.label: class_d_05_yes_01

entries.text: Oui!
entries.label: class_d_05_yes_02

entries.text: Très bonne réponse—great answer! Merci, my\nfriends! I knew I could count on you stars.[VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_05_language_03

entries.text: Leading up to the midterm, we learned all sorts\nof words from different regions![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_05_language_04

entries.text: Starting today, though, I’ll be throwing a curve\nball—for we begin listening comprehension![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_05_language_05

entries.text: Vas-y—go for it, my assistant! Pika pi, Pikachu![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_05_language_06

entries.text: Pikachu!
entries.label: class_d_05_poke_01

entries.text: As you just heard, Pokémon can also use words\nto communicate![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_05_language_07

entries.text: It’s not always easy for us to understand them,\nbut their words have meaning—just as ours do.[VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_05_language_08

entries.text: Pokémon can use language to share all kinds of\ninformation with each other—like the location of\r\nfood or whether there may be predators nearby![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_05_language_09

entries.text: The same Pokémon’s cries may sound different\ndepending on what it wants to say![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_05_language_10

entries.text: I’m sure you’re all curious, so aujourd’hui—today,\nthat is—let’s learn some Pokémon language![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_05_language_11

entries.text: Je t’en prie—if you would be so kind, Pikachu![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_05_language_12

entries.text: That’s right—I had my little Pikachu friend here\npretend to be angry for us![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.text: Don’t you think he did a great job? Give Pikachu\na round of applause, everyone![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.text: The same Pokémon can even communicate its\nfeelings in many different ways![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_05_language_18

entries.text: Their voices change depending on their mood\nand physical condition.[VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_05_language_19

entries.text: Try listening more carefully to Pokémon—you\nmight gain a deeper understanding of them![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_05_language_20

entries.text: That having been said, Pokémon are quite\nmysterious creatures![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_05_language_21

entries.text: Some actually don’t communicate with words at\nall, but instead use things like electromagnetic\r\nor ultrasonic waves—some even use telepathy![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_05_language_22

entries.text: And now, apropos of nothing, let me give you\nall one of my wise words of advice![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_05_language_23

entries.text: If you poke at your Pokémon too many times\nwhile washing them during picnics, they’ll get\r\nmad at you like Pikachu just demonstrated![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
entries.label: class_d_05_language_24

entries.text: Well, adios! Mata ne! À la prochaine! See you\nlater, everyone![VAR 0x0114(0026)]
